name: Aoba Kira
source:
"■■■■■■ kill ■■■■ ■■■■■■■■■■■■■ "

A girl who has been sealed away in the dungeon for many years, and has long since been forgotten by everyone in the village. Her ability of speech, as well as cognitive reasoning are severely underdeveloped, and are mentally equivalent to that of an infant. She has an uncontrollable desire to kill, and possesses a terrible magic. 

Flower: Meconopsis Horridula
Bloom Factor: [???]
Magic: [???]

[Translated by the [url=https://Acacia.wiki.gg/Kira_Aoba]Acacia Wiki[/url].]
